description: Calculates available absolute suction margin above liquid vapor pressure to prevent cavitation.
applicability_conditions: Liquid service, vapor pressure at operating temperature verified
applicability: suction line geometry and fluid vapor pressure known
non_applicability_conditions: Missing fluid vapor pressure at pumping temperature
assumptions: API 610 suction head datum at pump centerline
source_reference: API 610 Section 6.1.8 / Hydraulic Institute 9.6.1 — Engineering reference / prototype knowledge - requires engineering validation.
